source: Commercial Scout + Contact Verifier agents, public business websites, 2026-09-24

contacts.name: Springhill Ridge Apartments
contacts.manager: Burlington Capital Properties (Omaha). Springhill Ridge is listed on Burlington's own community list.
contacts.phone_note: Leasing office, Mon-Fri 9-5, closed weekends (property site FAQ). Burlington Capital Properties HQ main line 402-444-1630 (1004 Farnam St, Omaha), confirmed on Burlington's own site. 402-895-8614 on the property site is a FAX, so don't dial it. No public regional-manager line.
contacts.ask_for: Community manager. If they defer, call Burlington HQ and ask who handles capital projects and vendor bids for Springhill Ridge.
contacts.note: 15735 Rosewood St, Omaha 68136. 282 units, 3 stories, detached garages (year built: 2007 per scout, 2012 per ApartmentFinder, unverified). Correction: Burlington manages about 78 communities / 11,000+ units in 15 states now; '200 properties' is its 30-year total.

contacts.name: The Landings Apartments

contacts.phone_note: Local leasing line on the property site. Toll-free (833) 703-0166 is also listed. Office Mon-Fri 9-6, Sat 10-5.
